== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mortal [[Edict]] is a powerful entity characterized by the magic of death, representing the unavoidable and unstoppable end of all existence. She views herself as a solution to stagnation and a force capable of bringing mortality to those who are otherwise undying. Her power is immense, far exceeding the capabilities of advanced weaponry like the [[Zenith Cannon]]. Physically, she can manifest in a star form featuring a multicolored or rainbow-colored sun. In combat and social interactions, she displays a spirited, sometimes mocking personality, though she is capable of showing fascination with technology and can experience moments of weakness.}}
